_what_this_is: ADR-066 step 0. The fingerprint the gateway recorded for each blocked turn, read back out of the audit lake, beside sha256 of the DEPLOYED guardrail's own blockedOutputsMessaging. A match means Bedrock replaced the model's output with its own message and the gateway never held the text; a difference means something else came back. Nothing here can say WHAT - it reads a digest and a length, which is G4's boundary.
